BUF.head: Buffalo has a slight edge
BUF.body: Buffalo has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Not by much, though: Dallas can make it interesting if its penalty kill holds up.

DAL.head: Close, but Buffalo has the slight edge
DAL.body: Buffalo has had more of the chances over recent games and has home ice. Dallas can tip it if its penalty kill holds up.
